fusions.name: Flattening Drop
fusions.desc: Drops onto the target from up to 5 tiles away for 30 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, rising to 1.5 times the base damage at full reach.

fusions.name: Forepaw Slam
fusions.desc: Rears and slams both forepaws down, dealing 13 blunt damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Brace for the Swing
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

fusions.name: Settled Weight
fusions.desc: Each time you kill something, your physical damage rises by 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
